| --- | --- | --- |
| `category` | string | CMS plain-language procedure category. |
| `count` | number | Exact number of Medicare procedure occurrences when unambiguous, not unique patients; null for 1-10 and scientific-notation source artifacts. |
| `count_max` | number | Inclusive upper bound: 10 for 1-10, exact volume for integers, null for ambiguous artifacts. |
| `count_min` | number | Inclusive lower bound: 1 for 1-10, exact volume for integers, null for ambiguous artifacts. |
| `count_reported` | string | Unmodified CMS count string. Scientific-notation source artifacts are kept here without an inferred exact count. |
| `displayed_on_profile` | boolean | CMS marks N rows as not intended for display on clinician profiles, despite including them in the public dataset. No reason is supplied. |
| `ind_pac_id` | string | CMS PECOS individual PAC ID. Multiple PAC-ID rows may repeat the same NPI and procedure category; never add their counts together. |
| `volume_percentile` | number | Volume rank among clinicians performing the same category, not patient outcomes; null when CMS does not report it (including 1-10 counts). |
